name: facturacion
description: Invoicing for Mexican freelancers without an app: the deposits in your bank statements become the invoices to issue, checked against what was stamped, through the monthly declaration and its payment.

stays_local: invoice XML files, declaration receipts (PDF) and bank statements
RFCs, names, postal codes, foreign tax ids, property tax accounts, UUIDs and capture lines
the mxsat private store: templates and capture sheets with the real invoice data
the memory file (the agent queries it and sees the answers)
agent_sees: deposits: date, amount, type and account pseudonym
invoices: series and folio, dates, amounts, SAT codes, VAT treatment, pseudonyms instead of people
declarations: period, amounts and due dates
the owner's client labels and rules
everything the owner types in the conversation
cannot_guarantee: not opening documents or the private store is an instruction to the agent; host deny permissions reduce the risk but do not remove it
what the agent sees leaves the computer for the AI provider, under its terms
the memory file and the private store are not encrypted
the tax treatment comes from the owner's past invoices; this is not tax advice
